s0.ru: Цепочка из {species} видов. В начале {start} ядер вида 1, остальные виды пусты. Вид {species} стабилен. За один тик половина ядер каждого нестабильного вида переходит в следующий вид; ядра, пришедшие в этом тике, не распадаются. Сколько ядер стабильного вида будет через {ticks} тиков?
s0.en: A chain has {species} species. It starts with {start} nuclei of species 1, and the other species are empty. Species {species} is stable. In one tick, half the nuclei of each unstable species move to the next species; nuclei that arrive during the tick do not decay. How many nuclei of the stable species are there after {ticks} ticks?

s1.en: A chain has {species} species. It starts with {start} nuclei of species 1, and the other species are empty. Species {species} is stable. In one tick, half the nuclei of each unstable species move to the next species; nuclei that arrive during the tick do not decay. How many nuclei of species 2 are there after {ticks} ticks?

s3.en: The stable species has {stable}, species 2 has {daughter}, and the source species has {source}.
